mechanism: Both agents are ototoxic and nephrotoxic aminoglycosides/lincosamides; concurrent use increases risk of acute kidney injury and eighth cranial nerve damage (ototoxicity and vestibulotoxicity).
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) and auditory/vestibular function closely; consider alternative agents if possible; ensure adequate hydration and dose adjustment based on renal clearance.
